source.title: Open problems in active chaotic flows: competition between chaos and order in granular materials

trace.notes: Normalized the single URL source https://zbmath.org/2224182 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL.

The zbMATH web page did not expose a readable primary source through the available web reader, and local CLI fetching failed with network_or_dns_failure for api.zbmath.org. Local resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identified the exact record title, year 2002, and DOI 10.1063/1.1468247.

Identifier-specific recovery followed the DOI and exact title. Search-indexed candidates included Northwestern Scholars, Science.gov/PubMed-style abstract mirrors, author CV/reference-list mentions, and citation/reference pages. These were rejected because they exposed only abstracts, citation metadata, snippets, or references, not a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML article body.
No readable primary PDF or full HTML source artifact for the exact work was recovered, so no document map was constructed.

No candidates were extracted because the only recovered content was resolver metadata, abstract-only records, citation snippets, and reference-list mentions. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting open problems from those materials.
The run failed the source adequacy gate with failure modes metadata_only and network_or_dns_failure: no readable exact-work full text was available within the bounded recovery pass.
Saved the exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/2224182.json and outputs/latest.json.
